scenarios.name: Switch between temporary compact ribbon groups

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-drawing.odd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a drawing document is active in the MCAD Software
the Place Views ribbon shows compact group buttons
the user selects the Create group button
a temporary Create panel displays drawing-view commands
the user selects the Modify group button
a temporary Modify panel displays modification commands
the user clicks an empty area of the drawing outside the panel
the compact group buttons remain visible
